Announced before the games?

The proof works only when a build's fingerprint is public before its games: then the git host's push time shows the lineups existed in advance. 20 of 74 builds were announced when sealed; 12 were announced late and 42 never were (a publishing outage from 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-18, and builds made in the web app, which did not publish until 2026-11-19). Those receipts still verify against the chain, but say nothing about when the lineups were made.

Every sealed build

To check one: copy its sealed text exactly and SHA-256 it (for example printf '%s' 'TEXT' | sha256sum). The result must equal its hash, and its prev must equal the hash of the build before it.
